summary: Verified the newly built ,nuke moderation command in /app/commands/nuke.js via unit tests with mocked discord.js objects (no bot connection needed). Wrote /app/tests/nuke.test.js covering: command registration through commandHandler.loadCommands(), alias resolution mirroring index.js lookup, guild/DM guard, permission gating (neither, Administrator only, ManageMessages only), bot ManageChannels check, thread rejection, non-text channel rejection, and happy paths for GuildText and GuildAnnouncement including clone-before-delete ordering and embed delivery on the cloned channel. 30/30 assertions passed.
critical_code_review_comments: nuke.js: message.member could theoretically be null if the message is uncached; a defensive `if (!message.member) return` before reading permissions would harden the command, though the guild guard mitigates most cases.
nuke.js: catch-block sends DM to author but the original reply channel is already deleted; consider also sending to the cloned channel as a fallback.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discord.js v14 bot; no HTTP endpoints. Test nuke via `node /app/tests/nuke.test.js`. Uses hand-built mocks and real discord.js PermissionsBitField/ChannelType. All 30 assertions pass.
